about: The Wilderness Agility Course Dungeon below the course (Wilderness step W6.4): its eight level 25 skeletons, which the OSRS Wiki's page counts (read 2026-11-15), at the tiles mejrs' NPC list gives. Wander ranges are guessed until recorded. Not built: its four bones spawns, and the surface skeletons the April 2024 update added (no tiles).
